recipes.name: Cheese Pizza
recipes.desc: Dough, sauce, two cheeses and nothing else. The pizza equivalent of a plain white T-shirt, and twice as popular.
steps: ING_DOUGH stretched flat, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE spiral, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_CHEESE.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA and ING_CHEESE; spin the peel once.
cx: The cheese pull is only 1 stud long. Pathetic.
One wedge is bigger. That's my wedge. Wait, it's not.
recipes.look: Round golden pie with bubbly white-and-yellow cheese blisters, cut in 6 tidy wedges.
recipes.anim: Cheese strings stretch from the lifted wedge during ANM_043 (prop beam).
recipes.vfx: Steam wisps rising from the cut lines; cheese-blister pop sparkles.
recipes.mut: `MUT_136` Pizza Box Body (chef) adds a 'family resemblance' bark; Hot Hands shortens the bake for fire-tagged chefs.

recipes.name: Pepperoni Pizza
recipes.desc: Cheese pizza wearing eight spicy coins like a pirate's treasure. Pirates have tried to bury it. It was delicious.
steps: Slice the ING_PEPPERONI stick into 8 coins.
ING_DOUGH, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_PEPPERONI coins in a ring.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA and ING_PEPPERONI until the coins cup.
cx: Seven coins. SEVEN. Where is my eighth coin?
The pepperoni isn't curly. I need curly.
recipes.look: Classic pie with eight cupped red coins, each holding a tiny shiny sheen pool.
recipes.anim: Pepperoni coins curl up in the oven (prop morph over the bake).
recipes.vfx: Spice-fleck sparkles; small steam puffs.
recipes.mut: `ABL_064` Super Sniff reveals hidden COUNT mods on the coins; `MUT_017` Lizard Head chefs flick a coin into place (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Veggie Pizza
recipes.desc: Four vegetables walk onto a pizza. That's it, that's the joke. The Health Nut Hamster laughs every single time.
steps: Slice ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_OLIVE and ING_ONION.
ING_DOUGH, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_OLIVE, ING_ONION.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_OLIVE and ING_ONION.
cx: Is that mushroom smiling at me?
I can taste the vitamins and I don't like it.
recipes.look: Colourful confetti of green, red, black and brown pieces over a golden cheese sea.
recipes.anim: Mushrooms boing once when placed (prop squash-stretch).
recipes.vfx: Green leafy sparkle on plating.
recipes.mut: Plant-tagged parts (`MUT_158` Vine Arm, `MUT_177` Leaf Hands) widen the chop zone for all four vegetables (Green Thumb).

recipes.name: Pineapple Pizza (Controversial)
recipes.desc: Ham and pineapple on a pizza. Half of Morph City loves it, half have started a petition, and the Karenosaurus has started three.
steps: Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_HAM and ING_PINEAPPLE.
Slice and plate; brace for opinions.
cx: Fruit. On. Pizza. I'm calling my lawyer.
Not ENOUGH pineapple. Controversially.
recipes.look: Pie with yellow pineapple cubes and pink ham squares; a tiny protest sign pokes out of one slice.
recipes.anim: A tiny 'YES'/'NO' sign flips when the plate is set down (prop flip).
recipes.vfx: Split-screen spark burst: half hearts, half grumpy clouds.
recipes.mut: `MUT_063` Toucan Beak (chef) gets a tropical bark; `MUT_018` Pumpkin Head chefs are 'neutral on the issue'.

recipes.name: Meat Mountain Pizza
recipes.desc: Pepperoni, bacon, ham and sausage piled so high the cheese needs a map. Vegetables were invited and declined.
steps: Chop ING_BACON, ING_HAM and ING_SAUSAGE; coin the ING_PEPPERONI.
Pre-crisp ING_SAUSAGE and ING_BACON in the pan; toss twice.
ING_DOUGH, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_SAUSAGE, ING_BACON, ING_HAM, ING_PEPPERONI peak.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_SAUSAGE, ING_BACON, ING_HAM and ING_PEPPERONI.
Slice and plate with a tiny summit flag.
cx: I can see cheese. That means not enough meat.
The summit flag is missing. Did someone climb it?
recipes.look: A heap of meat in the centre of the pie, peaking at 0.75 studs, with a tiny summit flag.
recipes.anim: Customer leans back with ANM_043 'food coma' hold for 1 s after eating.
recipes.vfx: Small rockslide of crumbs when a wedge is lifted.
recipes.mut: Hot Hands applies to both the SAUTE and the BAKE; `MUT_050` Pig Snout chefs get a respectful nod from the ham.

recipes.name: Eyeball Pizza
recipes.desc: Four gummy eyeballs with olive pupils stare up from a cheesy pie. They follow you around the room. Delicious, and slightly judgmental.
steps: ING_DOUGH, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_GUMMY_EYEBALL ×4, ING_OLIVE pupils.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_GUMMY_EYEBALL and ING_OLIVE; spin so every eye faces up.
Plate with the eyes facing the customer.
cx: That one blinked. Is it allowed to blink?
They're not looking AT me. Rude.
recipes.look: Cheese pizza with four big jelly eyeballs whose olive pupils track the nearest player.
recipes.anim: Eyeballs blink in sequence (decal flipbook) and track the customer's head (client look-at).
recipes.vfx: Comic 'stare lines' around the pie for 2 s.
recipes.mut: `MUT_071` Googly Eyes and `MUT_077` Chameleon Eyes chefs get a staring contest bark; Kitchen Pro widens the bake window.

recipes.name: Tentacle Supreme
recipes.desc: Pre-seared tentacles sprawl across a supreme pie like a friendly octopus giving it a hug. Eight-arm service, one-arm prices.
steps: Pre-sear both ING_TENTACLE; flip as they curl.
ING_DOUGH, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_OLIVE, ING_ONION, ING_TENTACLE pair hugging the rim.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_OLIVE, ING_ONION and ING_TENTACLE.
Slice around the tentacles and plate.
cx: Supreme? It's barely Above Average.
The tentacle hugged my slice and won't let go.
recipes.look: Supreme pizza with two purple tentacles curling around the rim like arms around a friend.
recipes.anim: Tentacles give the pie a squeeze (prop bones) when it's set down.
recipes.vfx: Bubble trail along the tentacles; heart-shaped steam puff.
recipes.mut: Tentacle parts (`MUT_195` Octopus Tentacle Legs, `MUT_165` Kraken Tentacle Arm): Many Hands on the assembly; Sea Legs on the sear.

recipes.name: Lava Pizza
recipes.desc: Glowing Lava Sauce, blistered Lava Peppers and pepperoni 'rocks'. It doesn't burn the mouth — it just makes your ears whistle like a kettle.
steps: Slice ING_LAVA_PEPPER into rings; coin the ING_PEPPERONI.
Wake the ING_LAVA_PEPPER rings in a dry pan; two tosses.
ING_DOUGH, ING_LAVA_SAUCE river, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_PEPPERONI rocks, ING_LAVA_PEPPER.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_LAVA_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_PEPPERONI and ING_LAVA_PEPPER until the sauce glows.
Plate on the black volcanic-stone tray.
cx: My ears are whistling in the WRONG key.
It's not lava, it's mildly warm magma.
recipes.look: Dark crust with glowing orange 'lava rivers' between cheese 'islands' and pepperoni rocks.
recipes.anim: Customer's ears emit a kettle-whistle steam jet (FX attachment) after ANM_043.
recipes.vfx: Pulsing orange glow (PointLight) on the sauce; cartoon steam whistles from ears (kid-safe, no flames).
recipes.mut: `MUT_034` Lava Rock Head and `MUT_163` Lava Fist Arm (fire): Hot Hands on SAUTE and BAKE; `MUT_254` Fireproof Skin makes the glow tray safe to carry (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Screaming Cheese Pizza
recipes.desc: Topped with Screaming Cheese, which shrieks a tiny 'AAAA!' every time it's cut, baked or bitten. Mimes hate it. Toddlers demand it.
steps: Cube ING_SCREAMING_CHEESE (it screams each tap) and chop ING_HERBS.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_SCREAMING_CHEESE and ING_HERBS; the scream rises in pitch at Perfect.
Plate quickly before it screams itself hoarse.
cx: It screamed in a minor key. I wanted major.
It stopped screaming. Is it OK?
recipes.look: Pizza dotted with orange cheese cubes, each with a tiny open-mouth hole.
recipes.anim: Cheese cubes bob up and down while 'screaming' (prop tween synced to audio).
recipes.vfx: Comic 'AAA!' text bubbles pop off the pie for 2 s (Reduced Effects: one bubble).
recipes.mut: `MUT_068` Megaphone Mouth customers scream back (cosmetic duet); the scream's pitch is the audio cue for Perfect, so loud-tagged chefs see a louder cue.

recipes.name: Pizza With No Crust
recipes.desc: A crisp disc of baked cheese pretending to be a crust, topped like a real pizza. The crust filed a missing-person report.
steps: Coin ING_PEPPERONI; slice ING_MUSHROOM and ING_OLIVE.
ING_MOZZARELLA and ING_CHEESE pressed into a disc base, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_PEPPERONI, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_OLIVE.
Bake ING_MOZZARELLA disc with ING_CHEESE, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_PEPPERONI, ING_MUSHROOM and ING_OLIVE until lacy-crisp.
Slide off the peel without cracking the cheese 'crust'.
cx: I found a crumb of crust. A CRUMB. This is a crust pizza now.
It's floppy. Crustless doesn't mean spineless.
recipes.look: Lacy golden cheese disc with bubbles and browned edges, toppings on top, no bread anywhere.
recipes.anim: Disc crackles and holds stiff when lifted (prop rigid).
recipes.vfx: Cheese-lace sparkle; small 'crunch' text on bite.
recipes.mut: `MUT_102` Chef Hat Crest (chef) widens the very short bake window; `ABL_066` Zap-Cook saves an almost-burned disc at GOOD.

recipes.name: Pizza With Only Crust
recipes.desc: All crust, no pizza: a stuffed crust ring brushed with garlic butter and parmesan. For people who eat the crust first and the pizza never.
steps: Mince ING_GARLIC and ING_HERBS; grate ING_PARMESAN.
ING_DOUGH ring, ING_DOUGH rope rolled in as stuffed crust, ING_BUTTER brushed with ING_GARLIC and ING_HERBS, ING_PARMESAN.
Bake the ING_DOUGH ring with ING_BUTTER, ING_GARLIC, ING_HERBS and ING_PARMESAN.
Plate with the hole in the middle, proudly empty.
cx: There's a hole in my pizza. Oh. That's the point.
Not crusty enough. Needs more crust on the crust.
recipes.look: A thick golden ring of crust with a parmesan dusting and an empty centre showing the plate.
recipes.anim: Customer looks through the hole like a telescope before ANM_043.
recipes.vfx: Garlic-butter shimmer and herb flecks.
recipes.mut: `MUT_143` Noodle Arm and `MUT_116` Noodle Neck (tall) chefs get a bark about 'rings'; Kitchen Pro widens the bake window.

recipes.name: Backwards Pizza
recipes.desc: Toppings on the bottom, crust on top, brushed with Rewind Glaze so it bakes in reverse. It tastes like a pizza you will have eaten tomorrow.
steps: Backwards: ING_PEPPERONI on the peel, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_DOUGH on top, ING_REWIND_GLAZE brushed over.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_PEPPERONI, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE and ING_REWIND_GLAZE; the oven clock runs backwards.
Plate crust-side up; slice from the back.
cx: It's pointing FORWARDS. I can tell.
I ate it before I ordered it and now I'm confused.
recipes.look: Smooth glazed crust dome on top, toppings peeking out underneath, a tiny backwards clock decal.
recipes.anim: Customer eats it starting from the crust edge with a reversed ANM_043 (played backwards).
recipes.vfx: Rewind swirl particles spinning counter-clockwise.
recipes.mut: `MUT_024`... no — `MUT_040` Glitch Head customers love it (glitch flavour bark); Many Hands builds the inverted stack faster.

recipes.name: Pizza Inside Another Pizza
recipes.desc: A baked mini pepperoni pizza sealed inside a larger fancy-cheese pizza. Cut it open to reveal the pizza within. Pizza-ception is now a word.
steps: Coin ING_PEPPERONI; slice ING_MUSHROOM and ING_BELL_PEPPER; wedge ING_FANCY_FROMAGE.
Inner: small ING_DOUGH, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_PEPPERONI.
Bake the inner ING_DOUGH pizza with its ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA and ING_PEPPERONI.
Outer: big ING_DOUGH, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_FANCY_FROMAGE, the baked inner pizza, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_PEPPERONI, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_BELL_PEPPER, sealed edges.
Bake the outer ING_DOUGH with ING_FANCY_FROMAGE, ING_MUSHROOM and ING_BELL_PEPPER; spin twice.
Cut the reveal slice (2 taps) so the inner pizza shows.
Plate with the reveal slice pulled out 0.5 studs.
cx: I found only ONE pizza inside. I was promised infinite recursion.
Which pizza do I eat first? I'm frozen with choice.
recipes.look: A tall domed pizza with a wedge pulled out revealing a smaller pizza inside, cheese strings bridging the two.
recipes.anim: Reveal slice slides out with a drawer-like tween; customer does a double-take before ANM_043.
recipes.vfx: Sparkle burst and 'WHOA' text when the reveal slice is pulled.
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands runs both bakes at once; Robot Accountant customers (`PER_015`) throw a recursion-error bark (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Square Circle Pizza
recipes.desc: A square pizza with circle toppings, sliced into triangles to upset every shape equally. Customers allergic to circles should order it without them.
steps: Square-cut ING_CHEESE; coin ING_PEPPERONI; ring ING_OLIVE; round ING_TOMATO.
ING_DOUGH pressed square, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_CHEESE squares, ING_PEPPERONI circles, ING_OLIVE circles, ING_TOMATO circles.
Bake the square ING_DOUGH with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_CHEESE, ING_PEPPERONI, ING_OLIVE and ING_TOMATO.
Plate on a round tray, for maximum geometry.
cx: The circles are slightly oval. I measured.
Triangles?! I ordered SHAPES, not THIS.
recipes.look: Square crust in a checkerboard of cheese squares, polka-dotted with pepperoni, olive and tomato circles.
recipes.anim: Shapes on the pie spin 90° once when served (prop decal tween).
recipes.vfx: Geometric sparkle (squares, circles, triangles) burst.
recipes.mut: Square Cut / Spiral Cut chop modes (§5.4.12) are fastest for `claw` chefs on the meat (Pincer Prep); `MUT_022` Robot Head chefs see a measuring overlay (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Galaxy Pizza
recipes.desc: A deep-space pie: Galaxy Glaze nebula swirls, Moon Cheese crescents and blueberry planets, finished with sprinkle stars. Gravity sold separately.
steps: Nebula sauce: ING_GALAXY_GLAZE first, then fold in ING_BLUEBERRY planets.
ING_DOUGH, ING_GALAXY_GLAZE nebula with ING_BLUEBERRY, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_MOON_CHEESE crescents, ING_SPRINKLES stars.
Bake ING_DOUGH with ING_GALAXY_GLAZE, ING_BLUEBERRY, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_MOON_CHEESE and ING_SPRINKLES; spin twice to swirl the nebula.
Plate on the black starfield tray and give it a spin.
cx: The nebula is swirling clockwise. Space is ANTI-clockwise.
I counted the stars. You owe me four.
recipes.look: Deep purple-blue glaze with swirling galaxy arms, pale moon crescents and blue planet berries, twinkling sprinkle stars.
recipes.anim: The glaze swirl slowly rotates on the plate (texture scroll) while the customer eats.
recipes.vfx: Twinkling star particles and a soft purple glow (Reduced Effects: static twinkle decal).
recipes.mut: `MUT_279` Tiny Moons and `MUT_138` Cosmic Nebula Body (cosmic): Space Chef bonus on the alien cheese chop; Glow Guide on the glaze.

recipes.name: Basic Taco
recipes.desc: Crunchy shell, seasoned crumble, cheese, lettuce, tomato and salsa. It's a taco. It's fine. It's GREAT, actually, and it knows it.
steps: ING_TACO_SHELL, ING_TACO_MEAT, ING_CHEESE, ING_LETTUCE, ING_TOMATO, ING_SALSA.
Stand it in the taco holder.
cx: The shell cracked before I even bit it. Betrayal.
Taco Tuesday is a lifestyle. This is a Taco Wednesday.
recipes.look: Yellow U-shell standing in a holder, brown crumble, yellow cheese shreds, green lettuce, red tomato dots.
recipes.anim: Shell cracks in two on the first ANM_043 bite (prop swap) — always, by design.
recipes.vfx: Crunch shard sprites on the first bite.
recipes.mut: Kitchen Pro widens the sauté window; `MUT_167` Whisk Arm chefs toss with flair (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Crunchy Cheese Taco
recipes.desc: A regular taco wrapped in a lacy shell of grilled cheese, so it's crunchy twice. Double crunch, single regret: none.
steps: Melt ING_CHEESE flat into a lacy crisp (no flip).
ING_CHEESE crisp wrapped around ING_TACO_SHELL, ING_TACO_MEAT, ING_ONION, ING_JALAPENO, ING_SALSA.
cx: Only ONE crunch? I heard rumours of two.
The cheese shell is floppy. Floppy is not a texture.
recipes.look: Taco hugged by a golden, holey cheese lattice with jalapeño rings poking out.
recipes.anim: Two-stage crunch on ANM_043 (two shard bursts).
recipes.vfx: Golden lattice glint when plated.
recipes.mut: Hot Hands speeds the cheese crisp; `MUT_171` Oven Mitt Hands chefs can peel the crisp without a pause (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Burrito Blob
recipes.desc: Rice, beans, crumble, cheese, avocado, salsa and sour cream, wrapped into a lovable blob that refuses to be a cylinder.
steps: Boil ING_RICE and ING_BEANS in one pot.
Sauté ING_TACO_MEAT on the other burner.
ING_TORTILLA, ING_RICE, ING_BEANS, ING_TACO_MEAT, ING_CHEESE, ING_AVOCADO, ING_SALSA, ING_SOUR_CREAM, then roll into a blob.
Plate seam-side down so it can't escape.
cx: It's not blobby enough. I wanted a BLOB.
It rolled off the table. Is that a feature?
recipes.look: A round-ish foil-wrapped blob with a cheerful face sticker and filling peeking from the top.
recipes.anim: Blob wobbles like jelly when set down (prop squash-stretch).
recipes.vfx: Small steam puff from the open top.
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands runs both stove burners at once; tentacle parts roll the blob in one input (Many Hands).

recipes.name: Quesadilla Squish
recipes.desc: Two tortillas squish chicken, peppers and double cheese into a melty sandwich-disc, then get squished again on the grill for good measure.
steps: Slice the grilled ING_CHICKEN and ING_BELL_PEPPER.
ING_TORTILLA, ING_CHEESE, ING_CHICKEN, ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_CHEESE, ING_TORTILLA.
Squish-grill the stacked ING_TORTILLA disc so the ING_CHEESE melts; flip once.
Cut into 4 wedges; add the ING_SOUR_CREAM dip.
cx: Not squished enough. I want it flatter. FLATTER.
The cheese escaped out the side and now it's on my lap.
recipes.look: Golden grill-striped disc cut into four wedges with stretchy cheese bridges and a sour-cream cup.
recipes.anim: A cartoon 'squish' press animation on the grill (prop scale 1.0 → 0.6 height).
recipes.vfx: Cheese-string sparkle when wedges are pulled apart.
recipes.mut: `MUT_148` Gorilla Arm (heavy) squishes in one press (cosmetic bark); Hot Hands applies to both grill steps.

recipes.name: Nacho Avalanche
recipes.desc: A mountain of warm chips buried by a cheese-sauce avalanche, beans, crumble, jalapeños, salsa and sour cream. Dig in. Literally — it comes with a tiny shovel.
steps: Heat ING_CHEESE_SAUCE and ING_BEANS in a pot until bubbling.
Pile ING_TORTILLA_CHIPS, ING_BEANS, ING_TACO_MEAT, ING_CHEESE_SAUCE avalanche, ING_JALAPENO, ING_SALSA, ING_SOUR_CREAM.
cx: Some chips have no cheese. Unacceptable avalanche coverage.
The avalanche is too gentle. I wanted a disaster.
recipes.look: A tall cone of triangle chips with orange cheese sauce cascading down like a snow slide; tiny shovel stuck in the top.
recipes.anim: Cheese sauce flows down the pile when plated (texture scroll); customer digs with the shovel prop.
recipes.vfx: Cheesy 'rumble' dust puff; comic 'AVALANCHE!' text on serve.
recipes.mut: Many Hands piles two layers per input; `ABL_061` Extra Hands runs the pot and the pan together.

recipes.name: Fish Taco of Destiny
recipes.desc: Crispy panko fish, purple slaw, avocado and lemon in a warm tortilla — served with a tiny paper flag that predicts your future. It's always 'more tacos'.
steps: Cut ING_FISH_FILLET into strips; shred ING_PURPLE_CABBAGE; slice ING_AVOCADO and ING_LEMON.
Dredge ING_FISH_FILLET in ING_PANKO and fry; shake once.
ING_TORTILLA, ING_PURPLE_CABBAGE, ING_FISH_FILLET, ING_AVOCADO, ING_TARTAR_SAUCE, ING_LEMON wedge.
Plate and plant the destiny flag.
cx: My destiny said 'meh'. Was that the flag or the taco?
The fish is soggy. My destiny is soggy.
recipes.look: Open tortilla with golden fish strips, violet slaw, green avocado and a paper flag reading a fortune.
recipes.anim: Customer reads the flag (ANM_041 Read menu variant) before eating.
recipes.vfx: Sparkle when the flag is read; random fortune text bubble.
recipes.mut: `MUT_009` Fish Head chefs get an awkward bark; aquatic parts add Sea Legs burn grace to the fry; `claw` parts cut the fish faster (Pincer Prep).

recipes.name: Inside-Out Taco
recipes.desc: The shell is crumbled inside, the filling is outside, and the whole thing is held together by a grilled cheese crust and sheer willpower.
steps: Crush ING_TACO_SHELL; shred ING_LETTUCE; dice ING_TOMATO and ING_AVOCADO.
Grill ING_CHEESE into a large lacy wrap (no flip).
Warm ING_CHEESE_SAUCE in a small pot.
ING_CHEESE wrap outside, ING_CHEESE_SAUCE glue, ING_TACO_MEAT, ING_LETTUCE, ING_TOMATO, ING_AVOCADO, ING_SALSA, ING_SOUR_CREAM, ING_TACO_SHELL crumbs in the very centre.
Plate and point it the wrong way.
cx: The inside is outside but the outside is ALSO outside. Explain.
I bit it and found a taco. Inside my taco.
recipes.look: A cheese-lattice taco shape with lettuce and tomato on the outside and a glimpse of crunchy shell crumbs inside.
recipes.anim: Taco turns itself inside-out on the plate once (prop flip with a 'boing').
recipes.vfx: Swirl sparkle on the flip.
recipes.mut: Many Hands builds the wrap; `MUT_077` Chameleon Eyes customers see it 'both ways' (bark).

recipes.name: Hot Sauce Volcano Burrito
recipes.desc: A seared burrito packed with rice, beans, crumble and blistered Lava Peppers, with an eruption sauce core. Every bite releases a puff of cartoon steam.
steps: Sauté ING_TACO_MEAT on the second burner.
ING_TORTILLA, ING_RICE, ING_BEANS, ING_TACO_MEAT, ING_LAVA_PEPPER, ING_CHEESE, ING_HOT_SAUCE eruption core with ING_LAVA_SAUCE, rolled tight.
Sear the rolled ING_TORTILLA; flip once.
Plate standing upright like a volcano.
cx: It erupted on the wrong side. The volcano is facing AWAY from me.
Spicy level: suspiciously mild. I want my ears to whistle.
recipes.look: Upright seared burrito with a red-orange sauce 'crater' at the top and a steam plume.
recipes.anim: On ANM_043, a steam jet erupts from the top (FX) and the customer fans their mouth.
recipes.vfx: Cartoon steam plume and orange glow (no flames on bodies).
recipes.mut: Fire parts (Hot Hands) speed the pepper blister and the sear; `MUT_031` Dragon Head customers request extra eruption (bark).

recipes.name: Ghost Pepper Ghost Taco
recipes.desc: Grilled ghost peppers and chicken under a sour-cream ghost with gummy eyes. It says 'boo' when served and is legally a little bit haunted.
steps: Char ING_GHOST_PEPPER on the second slot (no flip); it giggles at Perfect.
Slice the grilled ING_CHICKEN; shred ING_LETTUCE.
ING_TACO_SHELL, ING_CHICKEN, ING_GHOST_PEPPER, ING_CHEESE, ING_LETTUCE, ING_SOUR_CREAM ghost, ING_GUMMY_EYEBALL eyes.
Plate in the dark corner of the tray for atmosphere.
cx: It said 'boo' but without conviction.
Not haunted enough. I've been more scared by a muffin.
recipes.look: Taco topped with a sour-cream ghost shape wearing two gummy eyes; translucent white pepper strips peek out.
recipes.anim: The sour-cream ghost wobbles up 0.3 studs and back down with a 'boo' (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Wispy white ghost particles; spooky purple tint for 1 s (Reduced Effects: tint only).
recipes.mut: `MUT_252` Ghost Sheet Cape chefs make it extra spooky (cosmetic); Hot Hands on both grill steps.

recipes.name: Mega Taco Tower
recipes.desc: Six fully loaded tacos stacked into a leaning tower, crowned with a fancy-cheese crisp and a single ghost pepper flag. Engineers weep. Customers cheer.
steps: Shred ING_LETTUCE; dice ING_TOMATO and ING_AVOCADO.
Warm six ING_TACO_SHELL on MED so they hold weight.
Batch 2: sauté the rest of the ING_TACO_MEAT.
Grill ING_FANCY_FROMAGE into a crown crisp (no flip).
Per tier ×6: ING_TACO_SHELL, ING_TACO_MEAT, ING_CHEESE, ING_LETTUCE, ING_TOMATO, ING_AVOCADO, ING_SALSA, ING_SOUR_CREAM; crown with ING_FANCY_FROMAGE and the ING_GHOST_PEPPER flag.
Plate on the tower stand; carry with two hands.
cx: It's leaning to the left. I lean RIGHT.
Only six tacos tall? I can see over it.
recipes.look: Six tacos stacked in a zig-zag tower on a stand, cheese crown and a white pepper flag on top.
recipes.anim: Tower sways when carried (ANM_007 Carry tray, wobble layer); customer eats top-down with ANM_043 loop ×6.
recipes.vfx: Crumb shower on each bite; cheer confetti when finished.
recipes.mut: Carry-boosting parts keep the tower steady; `MUT_115` Frill Lizard Collar customers cheer loudly (bark); Many Hands builds two tiers per input.
